meta.name: caveman-commit
meta.description: Write a Conventional Commits message compressed to intent only. Use for "write a commit", "commit message", /commit or /caveman-commit.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 浓缩代码改动为一句提交信息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常为提交信息措辞犯难,希望留下清晰记录。
copy.tagline_en: Condense code changes into one commit message
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often struggle with commit messages and want clean history.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把提交信息写成 Conventional Commits 格式，只保留意图，能省则省。它只产出可粘贴的代码块，不会执行 git commit、暂存文件或 amend。
howto.when: 当你说「commit message」、/commit 等关键词，或要求写提交信息时触发；说「normal mode」可切回冗长风格。

say.text: 帮我给这些改动写条提交信息
say.note: 输出 Conventional Commits 格式代码块

say.text: 这是破坏性改动，写提交信息

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude writes commit messages in Conventional Commits format, compressed to intent only, with an optional body. It only outputs the message as a paste-ready code block — it never runs git commit, stages files, or amends.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a "commit message", use /commit, or otherwise ask to write a commit. Saying "stop caveman-commit" or "normal mode" reverts to verbose commit style.

say_en.text: Write a commit message for these changes
say_en.note: Outputs a Conventional Commits code block

say_en.text: This is a breaking change, write the commit
